title: Pleasure still waiting to begin
meaning: Beautifully prepared leisure can remain on hold when preparation replaces meeting and the wish for quiet never becomes an invitation.
text: Sometimes everything for leisure is ready while leisure itself has yet to arrive. The Empress in the physical position of Svadhisthana helps you create something enjoyable: choosing materials for an activity, preparing a treat and making a comfortable corner. The Hermit in energy leans towards retreating into a private world, where listening to yourselves feels easier than reaching towards each other. The Hanged Man in emotions leaves a sense of suspension. You can stand beside a promised pleasure, viewing it from an unfamiliar angle without quite joining what is happening.

Suppose you buy clay to make amusing cups. Tools lie on the table and the tea is ready, but each person continues a separate activity. **Shared leisure begins with participation that needs no perfect readiness.** An uneven first lump already gives you a reason to exchange a glance. It need not become a beautiful object immediately. Trying can be your small shared adventure, bringing the prepared setting to life.

The difficulty comes when pausing becomes your only way to keep leisure free from demands. You impose nothing on each other, yet gradually stop making invitations too. Pleasant possibilities accumulate while the feeling of waiting grows. An unspoken wish can then be mistaken for no wish at all. A small invitation leaves room for refusal and also lets enjoyment move beyond endless preparation.
